title: The Last Seed
story: In a thirsty town, Sami finds one seed beneath a cracked fountain. The neighbours urge him to keep it safe, but he plants it in the square and shares his last cup of water. A green shoot appears. Everyone brings a little water, and the town grows a garden together.
logline: A child shares the last cup of water with a seed, and teaches a dry town how to hope together.
characters: Sami — curious child in a red scarf, small and determined; clear, gentle voice. Neighbours — varied silhouettes, supportive chorus.
palette: Terracotta, dusty cream, leaf green, sky blue
voice_plan: Narrator: calm, bright storyteller. Sami: childlike but natural; one short line. Avoid imitating a real person.
music_notes: Dry seed-shaker and soft hand drum at first; add plucked notes as each neighbour contributes water; airy flute at the garden reveal.
rights_note: Original procedural preview artwork. Replace or supplement with owned artwork for production.

scenes.title: A town out of water
scenes.action: Sami kneels beside the cracked fountain and notices a single seed. Dust drifts through an empty square.
scenes.narration: The town had forgotten the sound of rain. Sami found one tiny seed.
scenes.sound: Dry breeze, one soft seed rattle; music sparse and unhurried.

scenes.title: A little water
scenes.action: Sami opens his palm, then pours a last cup of water into the soil. Neighbours watch, then step forward with small cups.
scenes.narration: He could have kept his water. Instead, he made room for a beginning.
scenes.sound: Water trickle, cups set down one by one; a plucked rhythm gathers.
scenes.transition: Match cut from falling drop to a green shoot.

scenes.title: The garden returns
scenes.action: The seedling opens into a flourishing garden. Neighbours water together while Sami looks up into the bright sky.
scenes.narration: One seed became a garden when everyone helped it grow.
scenes.sound: Birdsong, soft flute, gentle communal voices without words; warm final cadence.
